Suggest environment improvements from replays, analytics, evals and comments

Collects failure signals from agent replays, analytics snapshots, eval reports and comments for a task, a quest or a time window, groups them into retro categories (navigation, automated checks, coding standards, steering files, tool economy, information access) and prints suggested changes ordered by severity. With --save the report is written to .wombo-combo/retros/&lt;YYYY-MM-DD&gt;-&lt;scope&gt;.md (git-tracked). Offline and read-only apart from --save.

```sh
woco retro [flags]
```

Read-only.

## Flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--task` |  | string |  | Only signals of this task ID |
| `--quest` |  | string |  | Only signals of this quest ID |
| `--since` |  | string |  | Only signals from the last N days (e.g. 7d) |
| `--save` |  | boolean |  | Write the report to .wombo-combo/retros/&lt;date&gt;-&lt;scope&gt;.md |

## Global flags

| Flag | Alias | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--output` | `-o` | string | `"text"` | Output format: text (default), json, or toon. Values: `text`, `json`, `toon`. |
| `--force` |  | boolean | `false` | Force overwrite / skip safety prompts |
